reason: The menu panel must sit above the sticky header (layer-header, 10) and below the drawer; no layer token names a menu, and the value equals layer-drawer only by coincidence. Move it to a menu layer token when the layer scale gains one.
A mask-image uses only the alpha channel, so the colour is never painted and has no theme value; #000 means fully opaque.
Stacking inside the table's own scroll container: the sticky first column must stay above the sticky header cells (z-index 2) it crosses. It never competes with page layers.
The list layout bundles the table rules itself, so the same sticky-first-column stacking applies inside its scroll container only.
The home title is a larger fluid display than size-display (clamp lower bound). It is replaced by the hero component's display size, so it is listed until that move.
The preferred value of the home title's fluid clamp; see the 2.75rem entry.
